content: दण्डकः .²1 A stick, staff <ab>&c.</ab> (such as a handle of a parasol, the beam of a plough, the staff of a banner). .²2 A line, row. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a metre; see <ls>App. I.</ls> .{@-कः, -का, -कम्@} <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated district in the Deccan situated between the rivers Narmadā and Godāvarī (it was a vast region said to be tenantless in the time of Rāma); प्राप्तानि दुःखान्यपि दण्डकेषु <ls>R. 14. 25</ls>; किं नाम दण्डकेयम् <ls>U. 2</ls>; क्वायोध्यायाः पुनरुपगमो दण्डकायां वने वः <ls>U. 2. 13</ls>, <ls n="U. 2.">14</ls>, <ls n="U. 2.">15</ls>.
